transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I can’t get past this feeling that I’ve failed. As a father, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, and… sometimes it feels like I don’t deserve much of a future.
Have you been having thoughts of killing yourself?

Yeah… I have. Not exactly like a plan, but… I keep thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up.

And I got scared because I caught myself going over my finances, like I was… getting things ready for someone else.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… most days feel pretty low. I haven’t really been keeping track hour by hour.
Did these feelings start after a separation or divorce?
No… not a separation or divorce. It’s been about a month, I guess. Since my daughter left for college out of state.
Do these feelings seem mainly connected to your daughter leaving for college?
I mean… it started around then. About a month ago, when she left for school out of state. So… yeah, I guess it feels connected.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to enjoy working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. Lately the trains are just sitting there half-finished, and even turning on a game feels kind of… pointless.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function in your daily life?

Yeah… it has. I’m not really keeping up. Bills, little house projects… they’re just sitting there because I can’t seem to follow through.

And I’ve kind of stopped seeing people, too. Book club, the guys I used to ride with… I just don’t go. I don’t know. It feels like it’s getting past something I can just ignore. I even started putting my finances in order, like… in case someone else needed to deal with them.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep?

Yeah. I’m not sleeping much.

I’ll lie there for hours… the house is just too quiet. And then if I do fall asleep, I’m up around three or four, and my mind starts going over everything I’ve screwed up. After that I usually can’t get back to sleep.
Before this past month, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?
I don’t know… not really like this. I’ve had bad stretches before, sure, but I don’t think I’d say it was the same.
Do these feelings seem stronger than you would expect from your daughter leaving for college?
I’m not sure. I mean… her leaving was hard, yeah. But whether this is more than that… I don’t really know how to measure it.
When you’re distracted or spending time with other people, does your mood lift much?
Not really sure. I mean, sometimes I can get through a conversation, but I wouldn’t say I feel… lifted. It’s more like I’m just not thinking about it for a minute.
Have you been feeling worthless?

Yeah… I guess I have. It’s hard to say out loud, but I keep feeling like I failed somehow — as a father, and just as a useful person. It kind of loops in my head, and then I start thinking I don’t really deserve much of a future.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah. I mean… it’s gotten pretty bad. I used to handle engineering spreadsheets without really thinking about it, and now I’ll sit there staring at a grocery list or a bill for half an hour and still not know what I’m supposed to do next.
Before this past month, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
I’m… not really sure. I’ve had low stretches before, I guess, but whether it was like this or lasted that long… I don’t know.
Before this past month, was there ever a time when you felt this depressed for at least two weeks?
I don’t know. I’ve had rough periods before, but… I can’t really say if it was this bad or for two full weeks.
Before this past month, was there ever a time in your life when you lost interest in most things for at least two weeks?

I’m not sure about before this month. I mean, I used to look forward to my model railway and watching Cubs games with my daughter… lately the trains just sit there half-built, and even turning on a game feels kind of pointless. But before that, I don’t really know.
Have you been feeling this depressed for at least two weeks?
Yeah… it’s been at least that. About a month, I guess. Since my daughter left for college out of state.
Before this past month, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I… I don’t really know. I’ve had low stretches before, but I can’t say for sure it was nearly every day for two weeks before this past month.
Do you feel depressed even when you’re not thinking about your daughter leaving for college?
I’m not really sure. It’s hard to separate it out… it kind of all runs together.
Do you feel depressed even at times when you are not thinking about your daughter leaving for college?
I… I don’t know. I haven’t really been able to tell. It’s just kind of there, and I don’t always notice what I’m thinking about when it hits.
